grammar.title: Yes/no questions with verb-不-verb
grammar.explanation: Repeat the verb with 不 between the two copies to ask a yes/no question: 是不是 (is or isn't?), 在不在 (there or not?). The 不 in the middle is unstressed and usually written with the neutral tone in pinyin.

grammar.title: 有 for possession
grammar.explanation: 有 (yǒu) means "to have". Sentence-final 了 after 有 signals a change: the subject did not have it before but has it now.
